title: Red Hat Security Advisory: .NET 11.0 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: .NET 11.0 for Red Hat Enterprise Linux has a low severity elevation of privilege vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-62909. This update includes security fixes, bug fixes, and enhancements for the .NET platform, which supports cross-platform application development. The advisory covers updates to SDK and runtime versions 11.0.100~rc.2.26504.105 and 11.0.0~rc.2.26504.105 respectively. The vulnerability allows elevation of privilege but is rated low impact by Red Hat. Updated packages are available for multiple Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 architectures.
